description_en: Enables HTTP/2 for negotiation between the server and client. The modification takes effect in one to two minutes
description_zh: 服务端与客户端协商时是否使用http2（修改后1～2分钟后生效）
kebab_example: aliyun mse enable-http2 --gateway-unique-id gw-0adf3ad751284cc69fcf9669fba00000 --enable-http2 true --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableHttp2

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2 for negotiation between the server and client. This parameter applies to requests. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
服务端与客户端协商时是否使用http2。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: enable_http2

parameters.help_en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 is returned if the request is successful

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic part in the error message
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_en: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic part in the error message. This parameter is used to replace the \%s\ variable in the ErrMessage parameter.

The request parameter DtsJobId is invalid if The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid is returned for ErrMessage and DtsJobId is returned for DynamicMessage
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`
`false`
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
